credential_handling: User-provided credentials were used only in the foreground Sysplorer login dialog and were not persisted in project files.
symptoms: Sysplorer title showed demo edition before recovery.
License dialog showed unactivated account-license state.
Output panel showed L5104-B0 / software not activated style failure.
MWORKS 006 return had a degraded baseline check caused by license variable-equation limit.
actions: Confirmed Sysplorer MCP server was reachable with session_manager probe.
Opened the foreground Sysplorer license login dialog through Windows desktop automation.
Submitted the user-provided Tongyuan account credentials once.
Confirmed Sysplorer title changed to education edition and license page showed remaining 150 days plus authorized modules.
Ran session_manager health after login; driver_ready=true and api_ready=true.
Ran a minimal Sysplorer MCP check_model for QuadrotorExperiments.Sunray150DynamicsWrapperHoverSmoke; ok=true.
reusable_rule: When a previously working MWORKS/Sysplorer workflow reports L5104-B0, unactivated software, a login prompt, authorization failure, or an unexpected license variable-equation limit, treat it first as a login/license incident. Department threads must stop solver/model trial-and-error and return an auth/license blocker or ask PMO for login recovery.
